title: Video Send
text: Send video stream to remote hardware, 4 inputs, {Format} sets Input video stream signal format; {Image signal} sets the nature of the RGB image input signal One multidimensional, {Compression}, {Quality}, {Max frame time (ms)} sets the maximum time per frame, {Remote address} sets the remote IP address 127.0.0.1 and {Remote port} sets the remote IP port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: RGB or grayscale image signal to stream M -by- N -by- 3 matrix | M -by- N matrix

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red channel signal of the RGB image to stream M -by- N matrix.

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green channel signal of the RGB image to stream M -by- N matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue channel signal of the RGB image to stream M -by- N matrix

params.name: Format
params.values: Input video stream signal format RGB (default) | Grayscale | Grayscale (16-bit)

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Nature of the RGB image input signal One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals

params.name: Compression
params.values: Compression format for the video stream JPEG (default) | VP8 | VP9

params.name: Max frame time (ms)
params.values: Maximum time per frame 30 (default) | non-negative integer
